# Shop: test plan

Version 1.0.0 of the specification: 1 design test, 0 golden and 1 red, about 1 subject. Golden tests show a path that succeeds, red tests a path that is refused. The test cases follow the test case specification of ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3.

## 1. Levels and how the tests run

| Level | Design tests |

System and acceptance tests are design tests, written in the specification and run by every implementation. Unit and integration tests belong to one implementation and are listed with it below.

## 2. Test cases

### Operation createItem

#### create-item-too-long

Scenario: red; level: system; covers name longer than 40 characters.

- Given: a clerk
- When: createItem is called with a name of 41 characters
- Then: it is refused
